description: Ensure event tags are captured in Bronze layer from Polymarket API
steps: Verify Polymarket Gamma API /events endpoint returns tags array in response
Confirm Bronze events ingestion preserves the raw tags array in JSONL output
Test with sample event that has tags like 'Sports', 'Politics', 'Crypto'
Document tags schema: array of objects with {label, slug, ...} structure

description: Extract and normalize tags from Bronze events into structured Silver format
steps: Update Silver events schema to include tags column (Array of Struct or JSON string)
Add normalization logic in silver/normalize.py to extract tags from raw event data
Handle missing tags gracefully (default to empty array)
Extract tag labels into a simple string array for easier querying
Update Iceberg table schema for polymarket/events to include tags column
Reprocess existing events to populate tags column

description: Add tags to Gold dim_event table for API consumption
steps: Update dim_event schema in gold/dimensions.py to include tags column
Add tags column to ClickHouse dim_event table (Array(String) for labels)
Update gold load-dims to populate tags from Silver events
Verify tags are queryable with arrayContains() or has() in ClickHouse
Test filtering events by tag inclusion and exclusion

description: Create endpoint to list available tags with counts
steps: Create GET /api/v1/tags endpoint to list all unique tags
Query ClickHouse: SELECT tag, count() FROM dim_event ARRAY JOIN tags AS tag GROUP BY tag
Return TagResponse with: label (str), slug (str), eventCount (int)
Order by eventCount DESC
Add caching (5-10 minute TTL) since tags change infrequently

description: Add tag-based filtering to markets and events endpoints
steps: Add includeTags query param to GET /markets/advanced (comma-separated)
Add excludeTags query param to GET /markets/advanced (comma-separated)
Update service.py to join with dim_event and filter by tags
Implement has(e.tags, tag) for inclusion filtering
Implement NOT has(e.tags, tag) for exclusion filtering
Add same tag filtering to GET /events endpoint
Update OpenAPI spec and regenerate TypeScript types

description: Create database model for user-saved tag filter templates
steps: Create tag_templates table in PostgreSQL: id, user_id, name, include_tags (array), exclude_tags (array), is_default (bool), created_at, updated_at
Add foreign key to users table
Create Alembic migration for tag_templates table
Add unique constraint on (user_id, name) to prevent duplicate template names

description: Create endpoints for managing user tag templates
steps: Create src/prediction_data/api/tag_templates/ directory with router.py, service.py, schemas.py
Create TagTemplateCreate schema: name (str), includeTags (list[str]), excludeTags (list[str]), isDefault (bool)
Create TagTemplateResponse schema: id (int), name (str), includeTags, excludeTags, isDefault, createdAt
Implement POST /api/v1/tag-templates to create template (requires auth)
Implement GET /api/v1/tag-templates to list user's templates
Implement GET /api/v1/tag-templates/{id} to get single template
Implement PUT /api/v1/tag-templates/{id} to update template
Implement DELETE /api/v1/tag-templates/{id} to delete template
Limit to one default template per user (unset previous default on new default)

description: Create reusable tag filter UI component
steps: Create web/src/components/TagFilter.tsx component
Fetch available tags from GET /api/v1/tags on mount
Display tags as chips/badges with toggle selection
Support multi-select for both include and exclude modes
Add visual distinction between included (green) and excluded (red) tags
Emit onChange with selected includeTags and excludeTags arrays
Add search/filter input for large tag lists

description: Add tag template management to frontend
steps: Create web/src/components/TagTemplateManager.tsx for template CRUD
Add 'Save as Template' button to TagFilter component
Add template selector dropdown to quickly apply saved templates
Show template name and tag counts in dropdown
Add default template indicator (star icon)
Auto-apply default template on page load if set
Add edit and delete buttons for each template

description: Integrate tag filtering into markets listing page
steps: Add TagFilter component to web/src/app/markets/page.tsx
Update useMarketsAdvanced hook to accept includeTags and excludeTags params
Persist selected tags in URL query params for shareable links
Add tag chips to market cards showing which tags the market's event belongs to
Update market filters sidebar/header with tag filter section
Add unit tests for tag normalization in Silver layer
Add API tests for tag filtering endpoints
Add API tests for tag template CRUD
Update CLAUDE.md with tag-related CLI commands if any
Update OpenAPI spec with all new endpoints
Regenerate TypeScript types: npm run generate-api
